$comment: Dark palette for the offline topo style. This is a PATCH, not a style: each key is a layer id in topo-style.json and each value is merged over that layer's paint block by buildTopoStyle() in mobile/src/services/tile-service.ts. Structure (sources, filters, zooms, layer order) is never duplicated here, so a change to the contour tiers or a new layer only has to be made once — a layer with no entry keeps its light paint, and a test asserts every id below still exists in the template. Palette rationale: a near-neutral #14 ground with desaturated landcover, so the red main track, the amber route overlay and the white waypoint badges are the only saturated things on screen; contour lines keep their warm tan hue but lift in value and opacity, because brown-on-dark loses the contrast brown-on-cream gets for free.
